name: odbc.select
description: Executes a SELECT query on the current ODBC connection

max.description: Maximum number of rows to return; omitted or -1 returns all rows

multiple-result-sets.description: Whether multiple SELECT statements in the SQL input should be returned as separate child result containers

*.description: SQL parameter value; child name is used as the parameter name referenced by the SQL statement

scope.description: Requires an open ODBC connection created by [odbc.connect]

output.description: Returns one child node per row returned by the SELECT query

children.description: One row returned by the read; child nodes carry the selected column values, with each child's name being the column name or alias from the SELECT statement

*.description: Column value; child name is the column name (or alias) declared in the read
